tagline.en_US: shadPS4 is an early PlayStation 4 emulator for Windows, Linux and macOS written in C++.

description.en_US: shadPS4 is an early PlayStation 4 emulator written in C++. It allows users to run PlayStation 4 software and games on supported operating systems, including Windows, Linux, and macOS.

tips: Copy and paste between your computer and the streamed desktop, including images, works over HTTPS: port 3001 or an HTTPS reverse proxy. Browsers block clipboard access over plain HTTP.
